pr.title: feat(cli): add --from-path to nav commands so cd can follow a branch
pr.body:
In a worktree-per-branch layout, moving up the stack is a `cd`, not a checkout - and a program cannot change its parent shell's directory. `--from-path` prints where to go and lets a shell function do the moving; the README carries the snippet.

For a branch that lives here it checks out and prints `.`, so your current directory is left alone. For one in another worktree it prints that path without moving anything. Without the flag a collision stays an error - there is nothing the caller can act on, and exiting 0 would tell a script the branch changed when it did not.

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #281
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->
